articles.title: Defence minister approves grant of 'Miniratna' Category-I status to Yantra India
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has approved 'Miniratna' Category-I status for Yantra India Limited (YIL). This significant move reflects the government's strong commitment to strengthening India's defence industrial base and promoting self-reliance. The enhanced status will grant YIL greater operational and financial autonomy, enabling it to contribute more effectively to national defence manufacturing and reduce import dependency.

articles.title: China's top general probe to 'remove obstacles' in military: State media
articles.summary: China has launched a significant anti-corruption probe targeting top general Zhang Youxia and other senior defence officials. State media suggests this crackdown aims to 'remove roadblocks' and significantly strengthen the Chinese military. For SSB aspirants, this highlights China's focus on internal purges to enhance military efficiency and loyalty, a critical factor in understanding global defence strategies and geopolitical stability.

articles.title: Show HN: Ziggy – high performance lock free MPMC channel in under 200 LOC
articles.summary: This text describes 'lock-free MPMC' (Multiple Producer, Multiple Consumer) computing designs, using 'sequence-per-slot' for ultra-efficient, concurrent data processing. These architectures manage producer and consumer cursors across cache lines, maximizing system performance and reliability. Understanding such cutting-edge concepts highlights advancements in high-speed computing, crucial for modern technological infrastructure and potential defence applications.

articles.title: France's budget set to clear the way for Macron's military spending boost
articles.summary: France's delayed budget is set to pass, paving the way for President Macron's promised higher military spending. This aims to bolster French defense capabilities in response to threats from Russia's war in Ukraine. For SSB aspirants, this underscores a major European nation's strategic commitment to strengthening its armed forces amidst evolving geopolitical instability and challenges to regional security.
